The node binds only to “the mug” and checks the endpoint, so it can mistake a newly appearing mug for the moved source mug. Strengthen the binding/evidence criterion to track the source mug by its visible identity (blue color and shape) across both images, and distinguish relocation from duplication or replacement; require a clear source-to-edited correspondence before passing. Here, the original mug’s apparent position/identity is ambiguous, so do not treat the high-confidence pass as established evidence; preserve uncertainty if correspondence cannot be resolved. The partial reference constrains the aggregate, not this node’s atomic label, so investigate other requested progress or aggregation rather than forcing this check to fail. No transport or dependency failure is indicated.
